purpose: Describe an impression from visible signs or an imminent event.
keywords: ます-stem / adjective stem + そうだ; いい → よさそう.
The sky is dark, and it looks about to rain.
formation: ます-stem / adjective stem + そうだ; いい → よさそう.
restrictions: Appearance そう does not attach to plain verbs in the same way as hearsay そう.
mistake: Compare 降りそう, looks about to rain, with 降るそう, I hear it will rain.
